name: mcp-databnf
description: MCP server for data.bnf.fr, the Bibliothèque nationale de France open catalogue. Look up authors, works, editions and the Gallica links attached to them. No API key required.
long_description:
Ask the open catalogue of the Bibliothèque nationale de France about a person, a work, or the editions the library holds. Six read-only tools over its SPARQL endpoint: find who the BnF records under a name and which authority record is which, read the dates, places, occupation and the alignments to VIAF, IdRef, DBpedia, Wikidata and ISNI, find a work by words in its title, read its record, list the published editions with their imprints, and gather the links to what has been digitised. No API key, no account.

Two things shape what it will and will not say. The BnF licence asks for the source and the date of retrieval to be stated wherever the metadata are shown, so every answer carries both. And the BnF places its metadata and its digitised contents under two different regimes: Gallica addresses are returned as links for a person to open, and never requested.

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find a person in the BnF authority file by name.

name.description: The person's name, such as 'Rimbaud' or 'Arthur Rimbaud'.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Read one person's record: dates, places, alignments.

author_id.description: The identifier from search_authors, such as 'cb119219976'. A full data.bnf.fr address is accepted too.

include_depictions.description: Include the images data.bnf.fr attaches to the person. A well-known person can carry dozens, so they are left out by default. find_digitised gathers them with everything else.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Find a work by words in its title.

title.description: Words from the title, such as 'saison enfer'. Every word given has to appear.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Read one work's record, established or provisional.

work_id.description: The identifier from search_works, such as 'cb11970626n' or 'temp-work/22d7f68c1a4bdd081ad7ca791fd3b730'.

include_depictions.description: Include the images data.bnf.fr attaches to the work. A well-known work can carry dozens, so they are left out by default. find_digitised gathers them alongside the digitised editions.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: The published editions of a work, with their imprints.

tools.name: list_works
tools.description: The works a person is credited with, established or provisional.

author_id.description: The person identifier from search_authors, such as 'cb119219976'. A full data.bnf.fr address is accepted too.

tools.name: find_digitised
tools.description: Links to the digitised documents attached to a record.

id.description: A person or work identifier, such as 'cb119219976' or 'cb11970626n'. The argument is named 'id' rather than 'work_id' or 'author_id' because it takes either.

kind.description: What you expect the identifier to name. The catalogue is asked either way, and a kind it contradicts is refused rather than followed. 'auto' states no expectation.
